{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of sentinel values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}')

# Check for missing or invalid final biomarker values (if any)
print(f'Unique values in biomarker_final: {df["biomarker_final"].unique()[:10]}...')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1].index
print(f'Number of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicate_patients)}')

# Show sample_seq distribution for duplicated patients
print(f'Sample_seq max per patient (first 5 duplicated):\n{df[df["patient_id"].isin(duplicate_patients[:5])].groupby("patient_id")["sample_seq"].max().to_dict()}')

# Check assay_batch values
print(f'Assay batch distribution: {df["assay_batch"].value_counts().to_dict()}')"}
